text: In the autumn [c. A.D. 1020] Illugi [the Black] rode from his home at Gilsbakki with thirty men and arrived at Mosfell early in the morning. Önund [the chieftain at Mosfell] and his sons escaped into the church, but Illugi caught two of Önunds kinsmen, one named Björn and the other Thorgrim. Illugi had Björn killed and Thorgrims foot chopped off. Then Illugi rode home and Önund received no compensation. The Saga of Gunnlaug Worm-Tongue
